One of the available tools for such assessment is the International Union for Conservation of Nature Red List, a highly authoritative and objective methodology for classifying species by their extinction risk. A number of taxonomic groups has been covered by this assessment so far, but not moths — an important group of pollinators. This contract will produce a European Red List of moths.
